result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation is missing its icon, leaving an inconsistent and harder-to-scan tab bar.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the Orders tab shows only its label with no icon above it, while Home, Search, and Profile each have an icon. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab visually inconsistent and less recognizable.
issues.suggestion: Add an Orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph) above the Orders label, aligned with the other tab icons and using the same inactive styling.
